Data Coverage

EPS changes rebuild constituent earnings as EPS × implied shares, where implied shares equal market cap ÷ price, and then compare the summed earnings amounts. Positive observations are used and stock-level earnings changes are capped at ±100% for 4W/13W comparisons. Group contributions use base-period earnings weights. In comparison charts, 13W EPS change is linearly converted to a 4W basis (13W × 4/13) and compared with actual 4W change. Price & Attribution II also provides 1D and 5D views based on prior weekday observations. FY1/FY2 lines show aggregate forward-earnings estimate changes since 2026-01-01. P/E equals total market cap divided by total earnings; observations below 1x are excluded as data-quality outliers. Since-2025-07-01 price attribution uses start-date market-cap weights and splits the EPS×P/E interaction equally so EPS and P/E contributions sum to price return. Operating-margin observations outside ±200% are excluded from weighted averages. Price returns and the Europe heatmap exclude dividends. STOXX 600 market-cap and earnings weights are approximate because the source currency is mixed.
